question: In which of the following regions is Mount Kailash situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tibet**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mount Kailash** is situated in the **Tibet Autonomous Region of China**.
 
• It is considered a sacred place in four religions: **Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Bon**.
 
• Mount Kailash is the source of some of the longest rivers in Asia, including the Indus, Sutlej, Brahmap
